text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin has made her debut, but her 
true challenge is only just beginning—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to become someone acknowledged by 
everyone, winning on the ultimate stage is 
the only way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Classic Triple Crown set as next 
year's ultimate goal, it was decided she 
would first gain experience in the Hopeful 
Stakes.
